review_basis.source_pose: Fresh torque-off follower read after the completed pose-L return.
review_basis.command_anchor_rule: The reviewed calibration-capture gateway may snap the fresh torque-off shoulder-lift reading by at most 5 degrees to the calibrated command envelope before the frozen interpolation; the snap is excluded from sim-gap evidence.
review_basis.target_selection: A preregistered CAD-visible and tag-visible configuration that changes shoulder pan, lift, elbow, wrist flex, and wrist roll from every J/S/K/L fit pose.
